trial_contract: compute/run0/output never commits; original explicit static C API remains available when dynamic fix absent; rejected when dynamic fix attached
dynamic_hook: New internal fix LPS/VARIATIONAL/DYNAMIC: POST_INTEGRATE after fix nve/move drift, before Neighbor::decide. Complete failures trigger force_reneighbor at same ntimestep. POST_FORCE converts native density to N before final NVE half kick. setup scales fresh initial forces but never commits.
time_layer: First half kick uses x_n,d_n; drift x_(n+1); irreversible commit at x_(n+1) with U_old-U_new signed loss; pair and bond then use updated topology and d_(n+1); second half kick uses new force. Operator split, generally first-order at changing damage; do not assert second-order fracture accuracy.
accepted_step: Exactly one commit for each true Verlet::run loop increment of update->ntimestep; no commits in setup/run0. Restart token/history stays in versioned bond payload. Nonconsecutive/rescaled steps rejected after first commit.
mass_force: Original physical atom mass rho*V retained. Final force density (bond+pair) multiplied by V in native POST_FORCE before physical fix nve. Standard native kinetic energy then is physical J. No external force modifiers admitted after/before this scaler.

boundary.curve: Each grip +/- A*(1-cos(pi*t/T))/2 for load, hold A, unload A*(1+cos(pi*(t-T-H)/T))/2, hold0; analytic velocity. y,z fixed on grips only. Original geometry reused; this is newly frozen boundary loading, not the old five-bond kinematic protocol.
boundary.constraint_kinetic: All-node K reported; boundary work = trapezoid(-F_material) dot actual grip displacement + exact prescribed boundary DeltaK. The latter is explicit actuator inertial work; free-node K independently reported.

initial_tangent.scope: Actual intact 341 graph tangent at reference; not a global nonlinear/contact stability proof

contact.energy: Uc=sum over unbonded physical pairs 0.5*(15*kspring*V^2/horizon)*(r-dx)^2 for r<dx; native epair*V independently crosschecked
contact.topology_contact_jump: At d=1 switch, any new contact potential at fixed x is signed separate topology injection; do not hide in damage D.

ledger: W_boundary = DeltaU + DeltaK + D_damage + DeltaUc - J_contact_topology + residual. No damping. Signed bond topology energy is -DeltaD, reported separately but not counted twice. Momentum J_external=DeltaP_grip - dt/2*(F_grip_old+F_grip_new).
cache: Retain last accepted force/U for identical coordinates; 1 local solve if d unchanged, 2 if changed. Full graph d=1 returns zero elastic force/U without internal solve; partially failed stars keep exact elimination.

budget.P4_admission: Only after P3 essential force/history/topology/energy gates pass and credible geometry frozen

reporting.state_output: Every accepted P3 step: x,v,material/total/contact force, kappa,d,physical time,counters. Event IDs retained. No all-node prescribed-motion substitution.
